_comment: Content for the whole site. To add a note: name the PDF '<CODE> - <Course> - <Title> - Notes++.pdf', drop it in pdfs/ and add an entry to that course's notes[]. note.type must be one of: syllabus | lecture | lab | problem-set | other — the course page shows one section per type. Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD) so they sort as plain strings. level = year (1-4), used for grouping and colour. LATER: a backend/admin panel would generate this from a database instead of a hand-edited file.
